notes.title: Release Countdown Started!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34652920/da9a8a686a493bff25ac1307fca23429a3bc269a.png

Are you new to this title? Or did you came from the previous game? Do you have a controller? Keep it with you! That controller will help you survive all the dangers surrounding the Tomb of Senza.

Believe me. It's not going to be a walk in the park. Bandits? Monsters? Those are the least of your worries. The land is rotting thanks to the lethal miasma. Everyone is sick because of it and you are no exception.

If the monsters do not kill you, YOUR SICKNESS PROBABLY WILL!

See for yourself how wary the locals have become! You are not the only one stuck with the problem! Help them so they are willing to help you! Find out how to end the miasma and cure yourself!

==========

That idea above caught your interest? Press that wishlist button now!

- Ibrahim Indra Baskara
